crossRefs.note: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said…
Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?’

translations.web: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’”
translations.bsb: But he answered, “The man who made me well told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”
translations.kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
translations.asv: But he answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
